typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings (h1-h3) to give a modern, humanist medical feel. Use Inter for body text for maximum legibility at small sizes.

primary.name: Life Coral
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Key Highlights, 'New Life' metaphors

secondary.name: Trust Navy
secondary.usage: Sidebars, Footers, Strong Headings, Secondary Buttons

accent.name: Bio Teal
accent.usage: Success states, Medical icons, Growth indicators

global.spacing: Relaxed. Use p-8 or p-12 for section padding. Avoid cramping.

landing_page.hero: Split layout. Left: Typography. Right: Emotional/Scientific Image. Use 'blob' shapes in background for organic feel.
landing_page.features: Bento Grid style. Asymmetrical cards. Mix of text-only and image-heavy cards.
landing_page.stats: Simple 3-column row. Large numbers (text-5xl) in Navy, labels in Coral.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar Layout (Left fixed). Top Header (Sticky, Glass). Main Content (Scrollable, bg-slate-50).
dashboard.cards: White background, shadow-sm, border-slate-100. Padding p-6.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E07A5F] hover:bg-[#D0694E] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 bg-transparent rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-[#E07A5F] hover:bg-orange-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
cards.feature: bg-slate-50 hover:bg-white transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 p-8 rounded-2xl

modals.content: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 p-0 overflow-hidden

visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle background gradients only. 'bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-orange-50/30'
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers and toast notifications only. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/20

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-trust medical marketplace. Accuracy and cleanliness are key. Do not clutter the UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.on_forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Ensure validation messages are clear and red/orange. Split long forms (like Clinic Registration) into Steps (Stepper UI).
instructions_to_main_agent.on_marketplace: The product grid should be clean. 4 columns on desktop. Product cards must show: Image, Title, Price (highlighted), and 'Add to Cart' button.
instructions_to_main_agent.on_admin: The Admin dashboard should be data-dense but readable. Use Tables for Vendor/Clinic lists. Use Badges for status (Active/Pending).
critical_donts: DO NOT use 'bg-transparent' for dropdowns or modal backgrounds. It breaks readability.
DO NOT use generic 'Lorem Ipsum' for medical data. Use realistic terms like 'Cryopreservation', 'Pipettes', 'Incubators'.
DO NOT make the primary Coral color too neon. Stick to the earthy #E07A5F.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors: separates good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
